fields.help_en: The dimension of the current credit
fields.name: limit_period

parameters.help_en: The Credit limit configuration. If you submit the configuration multiple times, the subsequent configurations overwrite the previous ones
parameters.help_zh: Credit限额配置。多次下发后续配额配置会覆盖之前配置
parameters.name: credit_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to apply the configuration to all instances
parameters.name: apply_to_all

fields.help_en: The display density in DPI. Valid values: 120 to 600. The value must be an integer. This parameter is supported only by the matrix (CPS) form. The instance group (VM) form does not support display density. If you specify this parameter for an instance group, InvalidDpi is returned for the entire batch. The display density for the instance group form is derived from the resolution. If you do not specify this parameter, the saved value of the node is retained
fields.help_zh: 显示密度，单位 dpi，取值范围 120-600（含边界），必须为整数。仅矩阵（CPS）形态支持；实例组（VM）形态没有显示密度承载位，传入本字段会整批返回 InvalidDpi，该形态的显示密度由分辨率推导。未传时保留该节点已保存值
fields.name: dpi

fields.help_en: The resolution height in pixels. The value must be an even number. The valid values vary by instance form: 300 to 3000 for an instance group (VM), and 480 to 2640 for a matrix (CPS). This parameter must be specified together with ResolutionWidth. If you do not specify this parameter, the saved height of the node is retained. The width and height are validated separately, and there are no restrictions on the aspect ratio or the size relationship between width and height
fields.help_zh: 分辨率高度，单位像素，必须为偶数。允许的取值范围按实例形态不同：实例组（VM）为300-3000；矩阵（CPS）沿用现有范围480-2640。须与 ResolutionWidth 同时传入；未传时保留该节点已保存的高度。宽高分开校验，不限制横竖屏比例或宽高大小关系
fields.name: resolution_height

fields.help_en: The resolution width in pixels. The value must be an even number. The valid values vary by instance form: 300 to 3000 for an instance group (VM), and 480 to 2640 for a matrix (CPS). This parameter must be specified together with ResolutionHeight. If you do not specify this parameter, the saved width of the node is retained. If the value exceeds the valid range for the corresponding form, InvalidResolution is returned. The valid range for the matrix form is determined by the server configuration
fields.help_zh: 分辨率宽度，单位像素，必须为偶数。允许的取值范围按实例形态不同：实例组（VM）为 300-3000；矩阵（CPS）沿用现有范围 480-2640。须与 ResolutionHeight 同时传入；未传时保留该节点已保存的宽度。超出对应形态的取值范围时返回 InvalidResolution（矩阵形态的取值由服务端现网配置决定）
fields.name: resolution_width

parameters.help_en: The custom display configuration. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, the display configuration remains unchanged. If you specify this parameter, it must contain at least one valid sub-field. Empty objects or null values are not accepted. Unspecified sub-fields retain their saved values for the node. ResolutionWidth and ResolutionHeight must be specified together. If you specify only one of them, the InvalidDisplayConfig error is returned. Valid values for Dpi range from 120 to 600. Dpi is supported only by matrix (CPS) nodes. If the target node contains an instance group (VM), specifying Dpi returns the InvalidDpi error for the entire batch. The effective time varies by node type. Modifications to an instance group (VM) take effect immediately. Modifications to a matrix (CPS) take effect after the next container creation, such as a restart or reset. This operation does not automatically restart the node
parameters.help_zh: 自定义显示配置，可选。不传表示不修改显示配置；传入时至少包含一个合法子字段，不接受空对象或 null。未传的子字段保留该节点已保存值；ResolutionWidth 与 ResolutionHeight 必须成对传入，只传其中一个返回 InvalidDisplayConfig。Dpi 范围 120-600，仅矩阵（CPS）节点支持；若目标节点包含实例组（VM），传入 Dpi 将整批返回 InvalidDpi。生效时机按形态不同：实例组（VM）修改后即时生效；矩阵（CPS）需等下一次创建容器（重启或重置）后生效，本接口不会自动重启
parameters.name: display_config

parameters.help_en: The target version of AI Engine, such as 2607W1. You can also set this parameter to latest to automatically resolve to the latest available version
parameters.help_zh: AI Engine 目标版本号，例如 2607W1；也可设置为 latest，自动解析为最新可用版本
parameters.name: agent_version
